summary: Frontend bug-fix verified: ResultsTable now renders new STK (green bg) and SLS (purple bg) columns between MODEL and QTY. Loaded an existing upload (0b69226f) which had PO + Stock + Sales files. Columns render with correct positioning, colors, centered numeric values, and sortable headers (clicks dispatch without error). HOWEVER, every row shows 0 for both STK and SLS even though direct ASIN intersection of the PO and Stock/Sales files contains 20 / 16 matching ASINs — backend not populating the values in the response.
passed: STK column header present with green background, positioned between MODEL and QTY
SLS column header present with purple background, positioned after STK and before QTY
Data cells render centered numeric values with green/purple tinted backgrounds
Sortable headers respond to click (no JS errors)
Filter row / search bar still functional with new columns
Loading an upload from history opens results view with new columns visible
API /api/results returns 'Stock Quantity' and 'Sales Units (30d)' keys on every row

failed.issue: All rows return Stock Quantity=0 and Sales Units (30d)=0 even when the uploaded Stock & Sales files contain matching ASINs (verified PO∩Stock=20, PO∩Sales=16 on upload 0b69226f). UI displays 0/0 in every row — user complaint about 'missing data' is partially valid: columns exist but values not populating.
failed.evidence: Direct GET /api/results/0b69226f → 0 rows with Stock>0; reproduced for 8 different upload IDs (0b69226f, 1652236d, 16c8ab9c, 24509be6, 35261248, 5f8720a7, 97deec55, eeaf9947, be9a5fb7). Fresh upload via /api/upload also returns 0 for both fields. Screenshot of loaded table confirms all 31 rows show 0/0.

action_items: Investigate backend file_processing.py — Stock/Sales ASIN matching is not writing values back to the results items. Headers row in stock.xlsx is at row index 1 (second row), header row in sales.xlsx is also at row index 1; ensure parser skips the metadata banner row (row 0) before reading ASIN/Open Purchase Order Quantity/Dispatched units columns.
After backend fix, re-test by re-uploading PO+Stock+Sales and confirming non-zero STK/SLS values render in the UI.
